narrative.headline: Find Japan restaurants, inspect courses, and check a bounded shortlist before booking.
narrative.value_prop: Preserves source prices, conditions and party-specific availability observations in compact JSON. Complete reservations on the canonical TableCheck booking page.
narrative.auth_narrative: Tested public consumer reads need no credentials. This CLI uses undocumented website endpoints; the separately documented partner API requires approval, with pricing supplied during application.

quickstart.comment: Check the local command surface without network.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Japan restaurant discovery, course inspection, bounded party/date checks and booking handoff through TableCheck.
anti_triggers: Creating or changing reservations, holds, payments or waitlist entries
